title_ru: Осирис — Mendes: сестринские золотые объекты, genital-cover control и поиск мошонки

central_advance.mendes: The immediate gold sister sequence after CG 53469 was resolved: CG 53470–53475 are bands and symbolic/deity gold sheets, with no separately named scrotal/testicular cover.
central_advance.control: CG 53745 from Saqqara is explicitly catalogued by Vernier as Plaque (cache-sexe féminin?), a 7.0 x 8.2 cm, 3 g very thin gold female genital cover with a median groove and dotted pubic-hair indication.
central_advance.bundle_controls: Independent controls show penis+testicle/scrotum ritual modules: KHM INV 10077 has penis plus testicles separately formed as an insertable Osiris module; Morimoto 1989 documents a gilded resin penis+scrotum model beneath intact true genitalia in a Qurna mummy.

cg53745_control.morphology: slightly curvilinear triangle, point down; vertical median groove; dotted field interpreted by Vernier as evoking pubic hair

mendes_immediate_neighbors.CG53474_53474bis: gold Isis and Nephthys sheets, probably mould/recess formed
mendes_immediate_neighbors.CG53475_53475bis: gold monkey and falcon symbolic sheath-like figures

current_hypotheses_for_eggs: scrotal/testicular form collapsed within the basal mass of CG 53469
basal mass is only crushed continuation of phallus sheath
basal mass contains support/repair/residue unrelated to anatomy
a companion scrotal element had a non-adjacent inventory number
a companion element was lost during the documented Mendes 1902 provenance fracture
the funerary cover was intentionally phallus-only
